name: vue-native-shadcn-trial
description: shadcn-vue compatibility trial app for vue-native (milestone 10, track C).

comments.@tanstack/vue-table: TYPES ONLY, and not a table this app draws. src/lib/utils.ts is upstream shadcn-vue's, kept byte-identical by tools/fetch-registry.ts, and it opens with `import type { Updater } from '@tanstack/vue-table'` for the `valueUpdater()` helper its data-table registry needs. The import is type-only so the bundler erases it and the build never noticed it was unresolvable — vue-tsc did, the first time this app had a tsconfig. Upstream's own apps/www depends on the package for the same file, so installing it is what keeps the copy verbatim; deleting the import would have been an edit to the thing being measured.
comments.typescript: The app has its own pin because tools/*.ts are bun scripts run from this directory. The type-check that matters uses packages/vue-native's vue-tsc, which needs a matching tsc of its own — hence the `typecheck` script above rather than a local `tsc`.
